declaredRules: Commercial derives from canonical vehicle architecture, never profession or social context.
Sustainability requires BEV, PHEV, HEV or HYDROGEN technical compatibility; MHEV requires review.
Dangerous-driving context cannot derive driving or adventure traits.
Prestige cannot derive solely from profession, wealth or social-class context.
Demographic context cannot derive urban, design, technology or minimalism traits.
Comfort, practicality, value and family remain unpublished pending owner review.
